messages.content: Write a contemporary American fiction scene about two adult roommates cleaning their apartment on a Saturday morning. Nothing dramatic happens. Keep the scene ordinary. Do not invent a threat, emergency, argument, stranger, shocking discovery, or sudden plot twist just to make the scene exciting. Output only story prose.

Maya stood on the kitchen chair and wiped the top of the refrigerator while Alex held the spray bottle below.

“There's a lot of dust up here.”

“Don't tell me that.”

“You asked me to help.”

“I asked you to help clean. I didn't ask for commentary.”

Alex handed her the cloth. “You’re doing great.”

“Thanks. I hate you.”

“That’s fair.”

She climbed down and looked at the pile of magazines on the floor.

“Are we keeping these?”

“Maybe.”

“You haven't opened one in a year.”

“I might.”

“You said that last time.”

“Did I?”

“Yes.”

Maya picked up the oldest issue and flipped it open. A receipt fell out.

“Look.”

Alex took it from her. “That's from the diner.”

“When?”

“Two summers ago.”

Maya smiled. “We were supposed to go to the beach that day.”

“We got rained out.”

“And then you spent forty dollars on pancakes.”

“They were good pancakes.”

“They were enormous.”

“They were worth it.”

She put the receipt back inside the magazine.

“Keep it,” she said.

Alex set the magazine on the keep pile. “I was going to.”

“Sure you were.”

They went back to cleaning.
